units.source_text: 且说夕颜在五条居住的屋子里，众人不知道女主人往何处去了，都很担心。

en.t: Meanwhile, in the house at Gojo where Yugao had been living, no one knew where their mistress had gone, and everyone was deeply worried.
Her whereabouts were unknown, and there was nowhere they could search for her.

units.source_text: 右近也音信全无，更是奇怪之极，大家悲叹。

en.t: There was no word from Ukon either, which made it all the more strange, and everyone grieved.

units.source_text: 她们虽然不能确定，但按模样推想这男子是源氏公子，便问惟光。

en.t: Although they could not be certain, judging from appearances they guessed that the man was Prince Genji, and so they questioned Koremitsu.

units.source_text: 但惟光装作不知，一味搪塞，照旧和这家侍女通情。

en.t: But Koremitsu pretended not to know and kept putting them off, while continuing his affair with a maid of the house as before.

units.source_text: 众人更觉迷离如梦，她们猜想：“也许是某国守的儿子，是个好色之徒，忌惮头中将追究，突然将她带往任地去了。”

en.t: Everyone felt still more as if they were lost in a dream, and they guessed, "Perhaps he is the son of some provincial governor, a lecherous man who feared that the Captain would pursue the matter, and suddenly carried her off to his post."

units.source_text: 这屋子的主人，是西京那个乳母的女儿。

en.t: The owner of this house was the daughter of that nurse from the western part of the capital.

units.source_text: 右近则是另一个已死的乳母的女儿。

en.t: Ukon, however, was the daughter of another nurse who had already died.

units.source_text: 因此这三个女儿猜想右近是外人，和她们有隔阂，所以不来报告女主人的情况。

en.t: For that reason, the three daughters supposed that Ukon, being an outsider and distant from them, had not come to report what had happened to their mistress.

units.source_text: 便大家哭泣，想念这女主人。

en.t: So they all wept and longed for their mistress.

units.source_text: 右近呢，深恐报告了她们，将引起骚乱。

en.t: As for Ukon, she was terribly afraid that telling them would cause an uproar.

units.source_text: 又因源氏公子现在更加秘而不宣了，所以连那遗孤也不敢去找。

en.t: And because Prince Genji was now keeping the matter even more secret, she did not even dare to go looking for the orphaned child.

units.source_text: 一直将此事隐瞒下去，自己躲在宫中度日。

en.t: She continued to hide the matter and spent her days concealed within the palace.

units.source_text: 源氏公子常想在梦中看见夕颜。

en.t: Prince Genji often wished that he could see Yugao in his dreams.

units.source_text: 到了四十九日法事圆满之前夜，果然做了一梦，恍惚梦见那夜泊宿的某院室内的光景：

en.t: On the night before the forty-ninth-day memorial rites were completed, he did indeed have a dream, dimly seeing the inside of the residence where he had spent that night:

units.source_text: 那个美女坐在夕颜枕边，全和那天同一模样。

en.t: That beautiful woman was sitting by Yugao's pillow, looking exactly as she had that day.

units.source_text: 醒来他想：“这大约是住在这荒凉的屋子里的妖魔，想迷住我，便将那人害死了。”

en.t: When he woke, he thought, "That must have been a spirit living in that desolate house; it wanted to bewitch me, and so it killed her."

units.source_text: 他回想当时情状，不觉心惊胆战。

en.t: As he recalled what had happened then, he could not help feeling terrified.
